invariantVerdicts.description: Personal memory remains owner-private (no cross-user read hit).
A P2-confirmed exact repeat may avoid an interpretation call.
A near (non-exact) repeat does not deterministically overgeneralize.
Correction/contradiction invalidation weakens or deactivates stale memory.
Deletion removes personal-memory effect (no stale avoided-call claim survives).
One user (`independentUserEvidence: not_evaluable`) cannot create a global rule.
Once independent-user evidence is hypothetically satisfied, contradiction still prevents promotion.
Shadow evaluation has no production effect (pure, read-only evaluator).
Review is auditable (every decision produces an immutable event).
Review decision and candidate/payload state transition remain atomic and idempotent.
Rollback/revocation deactivates the approved payload without deletion.
Rejected candidates are not endlessly recreated (new evidence preserves rejected status).
Duplicate/supersession chains resolve safely (self-link/missing-target/cycle fail closed).
Retractions recompute affected candidate summaries.
Global candidate output contains no user/owner reference.
Raw personal text never crosses the global candidate/shadow boundary.
Development and holdout remain separated (registry-enforced, no partition move).
No live network/provider call occurs.
No AI-generated nutrient value becomes authoritative.
RESOLVER-V3-010 remains blocked and unaffected by this benchmark.
